notes: Only the RNAseq arm of a ribosome-profiling series is a candidate; these libraries were made from lysate RNA with the standard TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Gold kit (not the footprint gel protocol), so assay_class total_rnaseq; flag if the 'mRNA-seq arm of ribosome profiling' exclusion is meant to cover this. Samples C/O/S/A carry plasmid-borne MS2-tagged ribosomes with different anti-SD sequences; which letter is wild-type anti-SD is not stated, so genotype_class, perturbed_genes and is_control are left out. Cold sample: shifted from OD600 0.65, phase left out.

base_medium.q: cells were cultured at 37 °C in 500 mL of LB + ampicillin (50 mg/L)

medium_class.q: cells were cultured at 37 °C in 500 mL of LB + ampicillin (50 mg/L)

amino_acids_supplied.q: cells were cultured at 37 °C in 500 mL of LB + ampicillin (50 mg/L)

inducer_added.q: IPTG was added (0.3 mM final concentration)

transcription_arrested.q: Ribosome profiling of purified MS2-tagged ribosomes with anti-Shine Dalgarno mutations from E. coli MG1655

mixed_organism.q: Ribosome profiling of purified MS2-tagged ribosomes with anti-Shine Dalgarno mutations from E. coli MG1655

assay_class.q: For RNAseq, libraries were constructed by TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Gold

rrna_removal.q: For RNAseq, libraries were constructed by TruSeq Stranded Total RNA Gold

treatment.q: IPTG was added (0.3 mM final concentration) when the culture reached OD600 = 0.3 and cells were harvested by filtration at OD600 = 0.5.
